lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least three visible longitudinal rows along the lateral flank; clusters in the central row exhibit larger diameters and higher peak pixel intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity crossing the longitudinal rows, creating a defined grid of high-contrast nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge feature along the dorsal-lateral margin, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper pixels to shadowed lower pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of six distinct elongated dark forms with high-contrast outlines (remoras) clustered in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral region.
